description: This is a front-end source file for a web-based database viewer application. It defines the structure and styles for the interface, including database and table navigation, data display, and user interactions such as refreshing data and expanding cells. The file contains embedded JavaScript for fetching data from API endpoints and dynamically rendering the UI.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the server and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, updates UI accordingly, and resets current selections.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the database to show its tables and initiates loading tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and renders data from a selected table, handling pagination limits.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Builds and displays an HTML table from the data array.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a table cell, handling nulls, objects, and lengthy content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses content in a cell to show full data or truncated preview.
